theme: An open day, with the Croatia countdown pulling.
greeting: The calendar's empty today, Dan - nothing lands until tomorrow's noon NACD call. The pull today is travel prep: the larder bin is due and the Croatia bookings are still open with your flight about a week out.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England call at noon tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: On your calendar for Sept 1 at 12, and you've already confirmed. Worth arriving with a clear ask - where you are on board readiness and the kind of seat you're aiming for.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 3 move to House 2 is the first real test of the rotating pantry. Building and packing it today leaves room to fix whatever doesn't travel.

needsAttention.title: Croatia lodging gaps are still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat night of Sept 19 and the St Pete gap of Sept 20-22 are both still open, and they have to be booked from dry land before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Get Croatia baggage confirmed in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buy bags now if they aren't included - counter fees run far higher.

flagged.title: OpenAI confirmed your application
flagged.detail: A received-and-under-review note from OpenAI recruiting - informational, no reply needed.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing invoice still unpaid
flagged.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 to Nautilus Sailing not yet finished - the balance on the Croatia course.

inbox.noise: LinkedIn job alerts, airline pre-trip notices, and the usual newsletters - nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: Central Maine Power autopay is scheduled; nothing to do there.

recipe.title: Onion Tart
recipe.why: As autumn settles in, a slow-baked savory tart suits the cooler kitchen and the last of the season's sweet onions.

tasks.title: Book refundable backup SUV, Sept 20 - Oct 5
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The calendar is blank - no meetings land today at all.
An unbroken open stretch, rare enough to spend on the one thing that's been waiting.
Home in St. Pete with the girls; the first fixed point is tomorrow's noon call.
